verdict.rationale: The USPTO publishes its own trademark application timeline page with tables of average wait times for new applications and for each stage of examination and registration (uspto-docs-32), including how queue placement works (uspto-docs-31). On the patent side it offers a first-action estimator (uspto-docs-29), so founders can see processing times for their transaction type directly from the service. Missing for 10: evidence that the published figures are current or how often they are updated, patent-side processing times beyond a bare tool mention, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
